rationale: A has lush glowing product renders and strong pinned scroll scenes (rotating object, six-step exploded stack, acoustic heatmap, card rail), but its percentage preloader is still at 93% three seconds after navigation, so the desktop hero is never seen and the mobile first viewport is only the loader; its dark-amber look with italic serif accent words is also a familiar premium template. B resolves a sequenced entrance by about 1.3 s (dimension lines draw, the HALO wordmark rises, the speaker lands in front of it with callouts) and commits to an engineering-drawing art direction made for this brief: sheet numbering, Copenhagen coordinates, polar and in-room response plots, a room plan, district-named wool colourways and a full orange pre-order configurator. B's hovers are plainer (colour inversion, underlines) versus A's custom cursor ring and amber fill, and B leaves a sparse stretch beside the sticky speaker in Materials, but its phone layout is clean throughout and it reads as the more complete and distinctive site.
